title: The Contradictory answer from the office
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：contradictory　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 contradictory 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the grower wrote of ① a contradictory answer from the office in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② more contradictory than the one named there the year before. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the contradictory ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most contradictory answer from the office anybody in the greenhouse had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1947 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too contradictory to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the contradictory ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a contradictory story of the fire, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as contradictory as the story of the fire they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was contradictory or not, and he said so.

By 1960 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something contradictory, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite contradictory; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the contradictory ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1963, year after year, she wrote of another contradictory answer from the office in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ more contradictory than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most contradictory story of the fire in the whole greenhouse, she said in 1965, was the one she could never quite name; the contradictory ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 矛盾（前置定语 a contradictory answer from the office：1953 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件矛盾的答复）
B. adj. 矛盾／相抵触（比较级 more contradictory than：文中两处，一处比办公室的答复，一处比预想）
C. adj. 矛盾／相抵触（最高级 the most contradictory：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 矛盾（表语 too contradictory to do：母亲觉得它太矛盾，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 相抵触（前置定语 a contradictory story of the fire：叔叔把整件事称作一桩相抵触的说法）
F. adj. 相抵触（同级比较 as contradictory as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩失火的说法相比）
G. adj. 相抵触（后置定语 something contradictory：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 相抵触（受程度副词修饰 quite contradictory：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a contradictory answer from the office
the most contradictory answer from the office anybody
a contradictory story of the fire
The most contradictory story of the fire in

answers.why: contradictory 意为“矛盾”，1953 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件矛盾的答复”，此处作前置定语 a contradictory answer from the office。
contradictory 意为“矛盾”，此处用比较级 more contradictory than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
contradictory 意为“矛盾”，收成账上 八月 那行字说它是大棚里最矛盾的一件，故用最高级 the most contradictory answer from the office。
contradictory 意为“矛盾”，母亲认为这件东西“太矛盾了，谁也用不上”，too contradictory to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
contradictory 意为“相抵触”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩相抵触的说法”，此处作前置定语 a contradictory story of the fire。
contradictory 意为“相抵触”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩失火的说法一样相抵触”，同级比较用 as contradictory as。
contradictory 意为“相抵触”，收成账上那半行字要的是“相抵触的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something contradictory。
contradictory 意为“相抵触”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当相抵触”，quite 修饰原级 contradictory。
contradictory 意为“相抵触”，1963 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要相抵触”，故用比较级 more contradictory than。
contradictory 意为“相抵触”，母亲 1965 年说的是“整个大棚里最相抵触的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most contradictory story of the fire。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件矛盾的答复。（a contradictory answer from the office）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更矛盾。（more contradictory than …）
母亲觉得它太矛盾，谁也用不上。（too contradictory to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩相抵触的说法。（a contradictory story of the fire）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩失火的说法一样相抵触。（as contradictory as …）
到了 1960 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件相抵触的东西。（something contradictory）
answers: In 1953 the grower wrote of a contradictory answer from the office in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more contradictory than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too contradictory to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a contradictory story of the fire.
He said nobody would call it as contradictory as the story of the fire they had once had.
By 1960 the ledger asked for nothing but something contradictory.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 contradictory 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the grower wrote of a contradictory answer from the office in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most contradictory answer from the office in the greenhouse, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too contradictory to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a contradictory story of the fire, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite contradictory, and everybody laughed.
The contradictory ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
